question: Which product is derived from limestone and diatomaceous earth, and is used as an antacid and as an anticaking agent in the preparation of food?
solution:
The correct answer is "**Calcium silicate**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Limestone** and **diatomaceous earth** are the sources of the white, free-flowing powder known as **calcium silicate**. It absorbs water physically well and has a low bulk density.
 
• It exists in cement under the name belite and is utilized in table salt, bricks, roof tiles, insulation, and road **construction**. In preparing meals, it serves as both an antacid and an **anti-caking agent**.
 
• Calcium silicate is frequently used to make industrial-grade **piping** and equipment **insulation**.
 
• In medicine, **calcium silicate** is employed as an **antacid**. It can be used in a variety of ways with building supplies. Calcium silicate is utilized as a passive **fire protectant **and has fire retardant qualities as well.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 __**Product**__
 __**Properties**__
 
 

 **Potassium sulfate**
 The **Mannheim furnaces**, which use potassium chloride and sulfuric acid as inputs, generate potassium sulfate. This chemical is employed in the** production of glass**, skin care products, cosmetics, and fertilizers.
 
 

 **Disodium phosphate**
 The white powder that is very **hygroscopic** and water soluble is known as sodium phosphate. As a result, it is employed economically as an anti-caking ingredient in powdered goods. In many **steam boiler** operations, it is utilized with trisodium phosphate.
 
 

 **Sodium ferrocyanide**
 One such coordination substance is sodium ferrocyanide. It is incorporated into food- and **road-grade salt** as a stabilizer and anti-caking agent for **welding rod coatings**.
